title: Supervisor (a) de Novas Instalações de Obras
description:
Nós Elevamos... Qualidade de vida urbana

Os nossos elevadores, escadas e esteiras rolantes transportam com segurança mais de dois bilhões de pessoas em edifícios e centros de transporte todos os dias. Como parte da equipe Schindler, você descobrirá um trabalho significativo que melhora a qualidade de vida das comunidades e contribui para tornar os locais mais acessíveis, inclusivos e sustentáveis para todos. Nós combinamos inovação, segurança e altos padrões éticos, garantindo respeito tanto entre os colegas quanto para o mundo ao nosso redor. Ao se juntar a nós, você não apenas se torna parte de nossa história de sucesso, você ajuda a moldar o futuro e continua nosso rico legado que começou lá em 1874.


No Brasil somos a Atlas Schindler, estamos no país desde 1918, com mais de 100 anos de história. Fabricamos, instalamos, modernizamos e prestamos o melhor serviço de manutenção para elevadores, escadas e esteiras rolantes. Somos líderes do segmento de mobilidade urbana no Brasil, e procuramos para trabalhar com a gente pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores, que promovam um ótimo ambiente de trabalho para colegas e realizem um serviço excepcional aos clientes.

Supervisor de Novas Instalações

Principais Responsabilidades:

Assegurar a execução eficiente, segura e com qualidade dos projetos de instalação de equipamentos, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos, custos planejados (PPG), conformidade técnica da solução vendida e satisfação do cliente, por meio da gestão de pessoas, processos, segurança e relacionamento com os stakeholders internos e externos.

Quais os Requisitos?

  • Superior completo em Engenharia (preferencialmente Civil, Mecânica e Elétrica), Gestão de Projetos ou Administração.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em Gestão de Projetos ou Operações

Conhecimentos Específicos / Habilidades:

  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos, planejamento e controle de obras.
  • Visão comercial e orientação para resultados.
  • Conhecimentos financeiros aplicados à gestão de obras.
  • Liderança e boa comunicação interpessoal.
  • Disciplina na execução de processos.
  • Perfil analítico e voltado à solução de problemas.
  • Forte orientação para o cliente.

O que você ganha com isso?

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Previdência Privada e Cooperativa de Crédito;
  • Vale Refeição (com possibilidade de desmembramento parcial para Vale Alimentação) ou Restaurante no local – de acordo com a localidade de atuação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Plano de saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Assistência Farmácia
  • Seguro de Vida e de Acidentes Pessoais;
  • Eleve-se (Atendimento e apoio de profissionais especializados em Psicologia, Jurídico, Assistência Social, Nutrição, Educação Física, Fisioterapia, Educação Financeira, Pedagogia, e Assessoria PET);
  • Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida;
  • Cesta de Natal e Brinquedo para filhos de até 11 anos;
  • Plataforma de aprendizagem online de idiomas gratuita;
  • Parceria de descontos com universidades e outras instituições de ensino.
  • Wellhub.

Nós Elevamos... Sua carreira

Faça parte da nossa equipe e nos ajude a melhorar a qualidade de vida e a impulsionar a inovação, elevando o nível de segurança e sustentabilidade. Valorizamos suas diversas habilidades e perspectivas, pois juntos moldamos as cidades sustentáveis de hoje e de amanhã.


Você está pronto para embarcar em uma nova jornada? Junte-se ao #TeamSchindler! Descubra mais em nosso site de carreiras.

No Grupo Schindler, valorizamos a inclusão e a diversidade, e praticamos a equidade para criar oportunidades iguais para todos. Esforçamo-nos para que todos os candidatos qualificados recebam consideração para emprego independentemente de idade, raça, origem étnica, cor, filiação religiosa, filiação sindical, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, estado civil, origem nacional, nacionalidade, genética e saúde ou deficiência.

Serão aceitas apenas candidaturas feitas pelo(a) proprio(a) candidato(a). Candidaturas realizadas por teceiros, agências de recrutamento ou headhunters, não serão aceitas.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (Java/Kotlin)

Location: Brazil, Costa Rica, Colombia

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (Hourly, no benefits, candidate responsible for taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 Months (with possibility of extension)

Working Hours: 40 hours per week


Role Overview

  • Senior Software Engineer on a newly formed Item Domain team (Sales & Retail: Pricing, Pay, and Merch Tools) for an authenticated luxury resale marketplace.
  • Focus on rebuilding core item data systems (pricing, merchandising, enrichment) through a mix of greenfield development and legacy system integration.
  • This is a high-impact role contributing to a long-term transformation of core data systems, leveraging modern backend technologies and AI-assisted development.
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering leadership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing to company-wide initiatives.
  • Develop backend services and internal tooling using JVM (Java, Kotlin) as a core focus, along with existing systems in Python and Ruby.
  • Build and support web applications for shoppers and operators (listing, enrichment, merchandising).
  • Work with technologies including React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB.
  • Contribute to technical decisions shaping future software systems and architecture.
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Collaborate through pair programming and support onboarding when needed.
  • Deploy user-facing code to production responsibly.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineering leadership, and stakeholders across regions.
  • Ensure observability and reliability by learning from metrics and incidents and maintaining systems.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and engineering workflows.
  • Continuously learn and apply new technologies, patterns, and initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 3–5+ years of strong backend software engineering experience.
  • Experience with Java or another backend language, with willingness to work with Kotlin (JVM-based systems).
  • Experience building and maintaining production-ready, reliable, and secure systems.
  • Understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka).
  • Strong communication skills with product, stakeholders, and engineering peers (fluent English required ).
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with distributed and US-based teams.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and deployment tools.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with focus on user impact and business context.
  • Openness to using AI-assisted coding tools in daily development workflows.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with JVM services (Java, Kotlin) in production environments.
  • Experience with Python or Ruby.
  • Experience with web technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React.
  • Experience building microservices and working across distributed systems.
  • Experience integrating LLMs or managed AI APIs into backend or internal tools.
  • Experience with eCommerce platforms.
  • Experience working with CMS tools (especially Prismic).
  • Experience with monitoring, dashboards, and incident response in production.


What We’re Looking For

  • Backend-strong engineer (full-stack experience is a plus).
  • Adaptable and fast learner with flexibility across technologies.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving, and greenfield environments .
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborative team player.
  • Open to AI-assisted development workflows and modern engineering practices.

description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Role Overview:

We're seeking a skilled Portuguese (Brazil) Voice Actor to bring characters and stories to life across various domains, using their voice to capture the right emotion, personality, and tone.

  • Access to high-quality recording equipment (for remote roles)

  • Experience with dubbing, ADR, or localization
  • Demo reel showcasing a variety of voice styles
  • Background in acting or performing arts
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.

  • This is a flexible agreement , not a full-time or part-time employment position.

title: UX Designer Pleno
description:
Buscamos um(a) UX Designer Pleno com perfil criativo e experimental para atuar no design de experiências imersivas de nova geração, combinando mobile, XR, Voice AI e Generative AI em projetos inovadores.


O que esperamos de você:

• +3 anos de experiência como UX Designer, com pelo menos 2 anos em apps mobile, produtos inovadores ou projetos end-to-end

• Forte domínio de Figma (3+ anos), incluindo contato inicial com Figma Make

• Mentalidade criativa, curiosa e inovadora, com vontade de experimentar e aprender

• Portfólio com projetos usando Vibe Coding, Generative AI ou ferramentas experimentais

• Exposição inicial a XR/VR e interesse por experiências imersivas

• Interesse genuíno em design guiado por IA

• Inglês para atuação em ambiente internacional


O que você vai fazer:

• Projetar experiências XR e interativas de próxima geração

• Criar aplicações mobile XR intuitivas, fluidas e centradas no usuário

• Desenvolver experiências de Voice AI e Voice UI com foco humano

• Colaborar de perto com o time para transformar ideias criativas em soluções reais

• Criar conteúdos e vídeos gerados por IA para pitch decks e storytelling


Por que se juntar a nós:

• Atuar com tecnologias emergentes (XR, Voice AI, Generative AI)

• Trabalhar em um time moderno, criativo e colaborativo

• Ter espaço real para experimentação e inovação

• Crescimento em design imersivo e IA aplicada

title: Data Engineer (Google Cloud Platform GCP) - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Senior Data Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience;
  • Hands on to design, develop, and optimize our next-generation data architecture. The core of this role involves building high-performance, distributed data processing systems using Google Cloud Platform, Spark and Databricks;
  • Fluency in English (B2);
  • Williness to move to Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: relocation to Portugal, mandatory.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: SR Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Financial Cloud
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Salesforce para atuar na personalização e automação da nossa plataforma CRM. O foco principal será o desenvolvimento de lógica de negócio robusta, escalável e integrada.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter componentes utilizando Apex (Triggers, Classes, Asynchronous Apex).
  • Criar e otimizar integrações via APIs REST/SOAP entre o Salesforce e sistemas externos.
  • Desenvolver componentes de interface (LWC ou Aura) e automações complexas (Flows).
  • Garantir a cobertura de testes unitários e a qualidade do código seguindo as melhores práticas da plataforma.
  • Colaborar com o arquiteto do COE para aplicar as regras de governança nos processos de CRM.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento na plataforma Salesforce.
  • Domínio da linguagem Apex e conhecimento de SOQL/SOSL.
  • Conhecimento em integrações e segurança de dados no Salesforce.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de deploy e versionamento (Git).
  • Experiência anterior em Financial Cloud.


Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

description:
Job Profile: Sr Golang Developer

Job Type: Long-time based contract Job Opportunity

Location: 100% Remote in Brazil


Job Description:


Job Description:

Specific Asks

  • 8+ years of experience with at least the last 2-3 years focused on Golang.
  • Sr developer
  • Ability to pick action items and work proactively.
  • Work independently
  • Excellent communication skills

JD:

  • 8+ Years of Software Development Experience
  • Able to apply functional and object-oriented paradigms.
  • Able to apply the SOLID principles.
  • Able to explain REST principles and design APIs that follow them.
  • Experience with SOA, micro-services, and/or distributed architectures
  • Able to architects systems and teaches others about appropriate software design patterns with eye towards scale and reliability
  • Stays abreast of cross-industry/domain technology solutions and able to advocate for new frameworks and technologies within their scope of influence.
  • Demonstrated ability designing and interacting with complex persisted data models.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a technical roadmap.
  • Able to both identify and improve poor performing code or database queries.
  • You are interested in continually learning and mastering new skills.
  • Able to communicate complex ideas and concepts simply and concisely.
  • You are willing to monitor and own the production services the team is responsible for and capable of leading multiple teams in troubleshooting.
  • Able to diagnose the most challenging production issues and implement the observability to provide this ability.
  • Able to lead efforts across enterprise technical teams to drive complex enterprise issues to root cause - along with a plan and measurable progress for resolution.
  • You are empathic and enjoy learning from and mentoring other engineers.

Nice to Haves

  • Open source software and dependency management
  • Object/Document data storage technologies
  • Caching and in-memory database technologies
  • Asynchronous/Multi-threaded Programming Patterns
  • Message queuing technologies/strategies

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios Pleno | Produto RH
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Buscamos um profissional estratégico-analítico para atuar na inteligência de expansão das soluções de RH. Este perfil não apenas organiza a rotina, mas provoca o crescimento através da análise de dados, monitoramento da saúde da base e suporte crítico à tomada de decisão da Coordenação. Espera-se maturidade para interlocução com líderes comerciais e senso de dono para garantir a rentabilidade e competitividade das ofertas.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

Inteligência Comercial e Gestão de Forecast:

  • Avaliar criticamente as solicitações de descontos, utilizando dados de margem e histórico de negociações para fundamentar recomendações de aprovação ou veto à coordenação.
  • Consolidar indicadores de performance (KPIs) da rede, transformando dados brutos em insights acionáveis para reuniões de diretoria.
  • Forecast: Apoiar na organização e acompanhamento do pipeline comercial
  • Inteligência Competitiva: \"Realizar benchmarking constante de soluções HXM no mercado, identificando diferenciais competitivos e gaps no nosso portfólio para municiar a coordenação com argumentos de defesa de valor e combate à concorrência.\"
  • Governança: Acompanhar e apoiar a Coordenação nos rituais de governança com as unidades de negócio (DRGs/Franquias), garantindo que as políticas de precificação e as regras de engajamento comercial sejam cumpridas de forma padronizada, reduzindo a necessidade de intervenção direta da coordenação em temas recorrentes

Gestão Estratégica da Base (Foco em CS e Expansão):

  • Analisar a taxa de ocupação e o comportamento de uso das soluções, apoiando no desenho planos de ação para Cross-sell e Up-sell em contas estratégicas.
  • Propor melhorias nos fluxos operacionais (propostas, contratação e faturamento) para reduzir o atrito e acelerar o time-to-revenue.

Articulação e Influência (Postura de Liderança):

  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico de produtos de RH perante o time comercial e áreas transversais (CS, Finanças, Produto).
  • Posicionar-se em fóruns de decisão, defendendo diretrizes comerciais e garantindo o alinhamento das unidades com a estratégia de expansão da companhia.

Capacitação do time de AR

  • Disseminar boas práticas e conteúdos técnicos de forma propositiva, elevando o nível de maturidade comercial da rede.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Capacidade Analítica: Conforto em trabalhar com dados para defender pontos de vista.
  • Resiliência e Firmeza: Habilidade para dizer \"não\" a pedidos comerciais que fogem da regra, embasando a decisão com lógica técnica.
  • Domínio de HR Tech: Entender as dores de um RH (Recrutamento, Treinamento, Payroll, etc.) para falar a língua do cliente e do time comercial.
  • Produtividade: Boa organização e capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas
  • Comunicação: Comunicação clara e facilidade de interação com diferentes áreas
  • Experiência com análise de dados e acompanhamento de dashboards comerciais
  • Vivência com fluxos de aprovação e processos de governança comercial
  • Noções de pricing (formação de preço, descontos, margem)
  • Experiência em operações comerciais estruturadas (Sales Ops / RevOps)
  • Perfil com viés de Customer Success, com boa gestão de interações e stakeholders


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

#Ouseetransforme #sejaTOTVS

title: Gerente de Projetos de TI Sênior
description:
Sobre a WWS

Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.


Sobre a vaga

Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.

Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.


Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.
  • Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.
  • Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.
  • Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.
  • Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em WMS.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).
  • Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.


Informações Adicionais

  • Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica)
  • Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil)
  • Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos)
  • Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte)
  • Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Back End Developer
description:
About the Role

StaffingAbroad is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer to join a #1 US-based FinTech & Crypto company . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in C#/.NET and has a strong focus on writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role Salary $5.000USD to $6.000 USD

English C1 required


What You Will Do

  • Develop and Maintain Applications : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/.NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.
  • Shape System Architecture : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across FinTech applications.
  • Write Quality Code : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.
  • Support Production Systems : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.
  • Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.
  • Focus on Security and Compliance : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with FinTech regulations.


What You Will Need

  • Strong Technical Expertise :
  • Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.
  • Proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).
  • Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.
  • Commitment to Software Quality :
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.
  • Experience and Education :
  • 6+ years of back-end software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
  • Collaboration and Communication :
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.
  • Cultural Fit :
  • Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in FinTech and Crypto solutions.


Plusses Include

  • Experience with iDesign architecture methodology .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, including their tools and services.

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in WordPress and HubSpot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.


This is not a classic WordPress role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern JavaScript and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.


If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,

brittle WordPress builds, you'll fit right in.


Key Responsibilities

Website Development

  • Design and build production-grade marketing websites in WordPress (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and HubSpot CMS (HubL templating, modules, themes).
  • Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate
  • prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.
  • Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).
  • Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.


API Integrations & Automation Hooks

  • Integrate websites with HubSpot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.
  • Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.
  • Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).


Quality, Performance & SEO

  • Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.
  • Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, HubSpot tracking, server-side events where needed).
  • Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.


Collaboration

  • Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.
  • Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/GitHub), and documentation.
  • Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.


Required Skills

Technical

  • 3+ years building production websites in WordPress (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).
  • Strong HubSpot CMS experience (HubL, modules, themes, forms, smart content).
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.
  • Comfortable in Git/GitHub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.


Modern Web Skills

  • Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).
  • Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).
  • Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
  • Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).


Bonus Experience

(Not required, but highly valuable)

  • Webflow development experience.
  • Headless WordPress or HubSpot setups (Next.js + WP/HubSpot APIs).
  • Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.
  • Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.
  • E-commerce experience (WooCommerce, Shopify).
  • Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.


Soft Skills

  • Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.
  • Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.
  • Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.
  • Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.


What Success Looks Like

  • In the first 60–90 days, you will:
  • Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.
  • Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).
  • Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (HubSpot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.
  • Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Career Framework Specialist - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cut-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the Role:


The Career Framework Specialist plays a crucial role in designing and maintaining organizational talent structures, translating complex role dynamics into clear, scalable career paths. You'll bring clarity to organizational complexity by crafting intuitive job architectures that support talent growth and alignment.


Key Responsibilities:


- Designing and maintaining career paths, leveling frameworks, and job families for Talent roles.

- Building and updating role definitions, responsibilities, and seniority distinctions.

- Ensuring consistency, clarity, and scalability across all Talent-related structures.

- Partnering with Talent Acquisition Leaders to align role frameworks with business needs.

- Documenting and communicating updates in a clear, structured, and globally usable way.

- Supporting audits and Talent processes by keeping role architectures accurate and standardized.


Requirements:


- Experience: 3+ years in Organizational Development, Talent Management, HR Business Analysis, or Job Architecture.

- Design Skills: Proven experience designing career paths, job families, or role architectures.

- Analytical Ability: Strong capability to analyze and structure information into clear frameworks.

- Communication: Excellent written communication and documentation skills.

- Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional HR or Talent teams.

- Technical Skills: Advanced experience with Excel/Google Sheets and documentation tools.


Desired Tools Experience:


- Documentation platforms like Notion or Confluence.

- Flowchart/mapping tools such as Miro or Lucidchart.


Personal Attributes:


- Systems and structural thinking.

- Passion for clarity and logical problem-solving.

- Ability to translate complex information into intuitive frameworks.

- Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

- Skill in collaborating across multiple stakeholders.


What to Expect from Us:


- Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the world.

- Competitive Compensation: Excellent payment in USD or your preferred local currency.

- Home Office Setup: Complete hardware provision for your workspace.

- Flexible Hours: Design your own work schedule for optimal work-life balance.

- Paid Leave: Parental leave, vacation, and national holidays.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Especialista de Machine Learning I (MLOps)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de plataformas e componentes reutilizáveis para o ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning.
  • Construir e manter pipelines de MLOps para automação de etapas como treino, validação, empacotamento, versionamento, deploy, rollback, monitoramento e retreinamento de modelos.
  • Apoiar a produção de modelos de Machine Learning em ambientes batch, near real-time e real-time, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Desenvolver frameworks, aceleradores, templates e padrões técnicos que facilitem o desenvolvimento e a implantação de modelos por diferentes times.
  • Atuar na integração entre modelos de ML, pipelines de dados, APIs, microsserviços, feature stores, serviços de inferência e plataformas cloud.
  • Definir e implementar boas práticas de CI/CD para Machine Learning, incluindo testes automatizados, validação de dados, validação de modelos, quality gates e estratégias de promoção entre ambientes.
  • Contribuir para a criação de padrões de observabilidade para modelos em produção, incluindo métricas técnicas e de negócio, drift de dados e de modelos, latência, disponibilidade, custo e performance.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Data Science, Dados, Engenharia, Arquitetura, Segurança e Governança para garantir aderência a padrões corporativos, regulatórios e operacionais.
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e arquiteturais sobre o uso de Machine Learning em contextos críticos do negócio financeiro.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
About LINES


LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.


We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.



What you'll do


  • Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style)
  • Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization
  • Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients
  • Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability
  • Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency
  • Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database
  • Design data models for high-write, real-time systems
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction
  • Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows
  • Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower



What we expect


  • Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset
  • Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization
  • Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs
  • Designs for scale even when the system is still small
  • Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it
  • Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar
  • Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency
  • Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering
  • Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities
  • Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality



Tech stack


  • Backend: NestJS (Node.js), TypeScript
  • Infra: AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare
  • Data: Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)
  • Frontend: Next.js, Expo (React Native)
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions



Nice to have


  • Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces
  • Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience
  • Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration)
  • Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video)
  • React Native or Expo

﻿

description:

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. title: Analista Linux Pleno
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Administrar, manter e evoluir ambientes Linux em produção (alta disponibilidade e missão crítica);
  • Realizar troubleshooting avançado de sistemas operacionais, redes e aplicações;
  • Gerenciar servidores físicos, virtuais e ambientes em cloud HP;
  • Automatizar rotinas operacionais utilizando Shell Script, Python, ansible ou ferramentas de automação;
  • Implementar e administrar soluções de monitoramento (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.);
  • Atuar em incidentes críticos, garantindo rápida identificação de causa raiz;
  • Aplicar hardening e boas práticas de segurança em servidores Linux Red Hat Enterprise;
  • Gerenciar patches, atualizações e ciclo de vida dos sistemas;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, redes, banco de dados e segurança;
  • Documentar procedimentos técnicos e manter base de conhecimento atualizada via Gilab e Azure DevOps.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólida experiência com administração de sistemas Linux (Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu, etc.);
  • Conhecimento avançado em troubleshooting (CPU, memória, I/O, rede, processos);
  • Experiência com virtualização (VMware, KVM ou similares);
  • Domínio de linha de comando e scripting (Bash, Shell Script e ansible);
  • Conhecimento em redes (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, balanceamento);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento; Munin e Zabbix.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Técnico de Manutenção Externo
description:
PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:


  • Realizar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em Linha Amarela ;
  • Realizar serviços pós-venda, como inspeção de entrega de equipamentos, manutenção regular e reparo de falhas;
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas, elétricas e hidráulicas nos equipamentos;
  • Efetuar inspeções rotineiras conforme checklists e normas técnicas;
  • Registrar manutenções em sistema e elaborar relatórios técnicos;
  • Garantir a segurança nas operações e o cumprimento das normas NR-12, NR-18, NR-35, entre outras.


REQUISITOS:


  • Técnico completo em Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada com manutenção de Linha Amarela;
  • Conhecimento em hidráulica, elétrica e leitura de diagramas técnicos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e/ou trabalho em regime de turno ou escala;
  • Desejável: cursos de NR-12, NR-35 e CNH categoria D ou E.

title: Risk Control Specialist (UTC+8 Night shift)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

description:

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills

Requirements

title: Vendedor(a)

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista Funcional de IA Sênior (Remoto)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


Atuação em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, com foco em soluções inovadoras baseadas em Inteligência Artificial e evolução contínua de produtos digitais.


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos funcionais de soluções com uso de IA;
  • Traduzir demandas de negócio em especificações claras, fluxos e critérios de aceite;
  • Apoiar o desenho de jornadas, regras de negócio e casos de uso;
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de produto, tecnologia, UX e operação;
  • Participar da validação de entregas, testes funcionais e processos de homologação;
  • Documentar processos, fluxos, funcionalidades e regras associadas às soluções;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de backlog e priorização de demandas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e experiências apoiadas por IA;
  • Contribuir com a evolução contínua das soluções em produção.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência com LLMs, chatbots ou agentes inteligentes;
  • Conhecimento em fluxos conversacionais;
  • Noções de APIs, automações e integrações;
  • Experiência com testes de IA e análise de respostas;
  • Vivência com ferramentas como Jira, Confluence, Miro ou Figma;
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em ambientes de cloud como Google Cloud e Azure;
  • Conhecimento em Databricks.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Visão de dono.


✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada;
  • Trilha de carreira.

title: Back End Developer With Data Exp
description:
Role: Data Engineer III (API) / Software Engineer with Data Experience

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract


Important:

We need a senior-level engineer with recent hands-on experience in Node.js and strong expertise in MongoDB, TypeScript, SQL, AWS, and API development .

Experience with GraphQL is a plus .


About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled backend/data engineer with strong experience in building scalable APIs and working with complex data systems.

This role focuses on Node.js, TypeScript, backend architecture, and data modeling , with exposure to cloud-native and event-driven systems .


Responsibilities

• Build and maintain scalable APIs (REST & GraphQL) for high-performance applications

• Design and optimize data models using MongoDB, NoSQL, and relational databases

• Implement schema design, indexing strategies, and transactions for performance and scalability

• Develop and maintain ETL pipelines and data ingestion workflows

• Collaborate on backend architecture , including microservices and distributed systems

• Work with cloud platforms (AWS/OCI) and containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes)

• Ensure code quality, testing, and best engineering practices across the development lifecycle


Requirements

• 6+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering

• Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript (recent projects required)

• Expertise in MongoDB and database modeling (NoSQL + SQL)

• Solid experience building REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus)

• Strong understanding of software engineering principles (SOLID, clean architecture, design patterns)

• Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, etc.) or OCI

• Experience with containers (Docker/Kubernetes)

• Strong problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have

• Experience with GraphQL APIs

• Messaging systems like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS/SNS

• Experience with event-driven architecture

• Exposure to serverless architectures

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, etc.)


Apply today or share your profiles to

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.


For more information, please see our video

description:
Senior Software Engineer (Java / AI-Enabled)

Rocket Financial builds innovative fintech products that improve how money moves globally. We work across multiple high-impact fintech projects , tackling complex problems in payments, infrastructure, and financial services.


We are a U.S.-based company hiring an international contractor located in Brazil . This role will work closely with a distributed team, including Brazil and Canada based engineers.


We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is primarily backend-focused but comfortable contributing to the frontend when needed. You’ll play a key role in shaping systems, building scalable applications, and leveraging AI tools to move faster and smarter.


WHY JOIN US

  • Fast-paced startup environment with high impact and real ownership
  • 100% fully remote role
  • Work with a U.S.-based company building cutting-edge fintech products
  • Flexible schedule with alignment to East Coast hours
  • Collaborative, international team with strong engineering talent
  • Opportunity to work with modern technologies and AI-driven development


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build and scale Java-based backend systems and microservices
  • Contribute to frontend features (React or similar) when needed
  • Design robust, scalable applications and system architectures
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Codex, etc.) to accelerate development and problem-solving
  • Write and refine effective AI prompts for engineering workflows
  • Collaborate closely with Product and Design to deliver impactful features
  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and agile processes
  • Debug and resolve production issues and performance challenges


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience (strong backend focus in Java)
  • Experience with Spring, microservices, and REST APIs
  • Comfortable working across the stack (React/TypeScript or similar )
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude, Codex, etc.)
  • Strong system design and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, CI/CD, and AWS
  • Able to thrive in a fast-moving environment and adapt quickly

title: Remote SwarmBench Task Engineer - 75063
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain
  • Strong ability to formalize constraints, dependencies, and scheduling logic
  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills
  • Clear and precise technical writing skills
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker (Dockerfiles, image builds, debugging)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)
  • Background in operations research
  • Experience with simulation or modeling tools
  • Knowledge of AI planning systems or automated reasoning

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer (L3) - Healthcare Tech Nonprofit


Want your code to actually matter?

We're hiring on behalf of a mission-driven healthcare technology nonprofit whose platform has reached tens of millions of patients in low-income communities across the US. They're growing the team that builds the SaaS product hundreds of safety-net clinics rely on every day to manage patients and run patient engagement programs.


This is a senior IC role with shared team-lead responsibilities - owning complex full-stack features end-to-end, mentoring mid-level engineers, and shaping architecture across a Rails monolith and React SPA.


The Stack Ruby on Rails · React · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Google Cloud · Sidekiq


What You'll Own

  • Driving the technical direction of key Applications platform features
  • Shipping full-stack work end-to-end: API → data model → UI
  • Mentoring L2 engineers and leading technical design discussions
  • Contributing to architectural decisions across the monolith and SPA
  • Sharing on-call duties and helping evolve engineering standards


What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years full-stack experience, with deep Rails + modern React fluency
  • A track record of owning complex features from design through production
  • Advanced SQL and a genuinely analytical, evidence-led mindset
  • Proven ability to mentor and influence technical direction
  • Excellent async communication — this is a fully distributed team
  • Real excitement about mission-driven work


Bonus Points

  • Healthcare tech, social services, or other practitioner-facing domains
  • Multi-tenant data models, RBAC, accessibility-aware UI
  • Experience scaling a Rails monolith with a React SPA frontend


Interested? Apply here or message me directly - happy to walk you through the role, the team, and the mission before you commit to a full process.

title: Analista de dados
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados que vá além de números — alguém capaz de transformar dados em insights estratégicos e apoiar decisões que impactam diretamente o crescimento do negócio.

Se você tem olhar analítico, curiosidade e gosta de encontrar padrões onde outros veem apenas dados, essa oportunidade é para você.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Coletar, organizar e analisar dados de diferentes fontes

Criar dashboards e relatórios para acompanhamento de performance

Identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades de melhoria

Apoiar equipes de marketing, produto e negócios com insights acionáveis

Monitorar KPIs e sugerir otimizações baseadas em dados

Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados garantindo qualidade e consistência

Automatizar processos e relatórios sempre que possível

REQUISITOS

Experiência prévia como Analista de Dados ou função similar

Forte habilidade analítica e raciocínio lógico

Conhecimento em ferramentas como Excel/Google Sheets, SQL e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

Noções de estatística e interpretação de dados

Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights claros e objetivos

Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade

DIFERENCIAIS

Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados

Conhecimento em Google Analytics, BigQuery ou ferramentas de tracking

Experiência em ambientes de marketing ou produto

BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração compatível com o mercado

Bônus por desempenho (conforme política da empresa)

Ambiente colaborativo, orientado a dados e inovação

Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional
