title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior | Databricks e Inglês Avançado
description:
Muito prazer, somos a United Hub Digital, uma consultoria de tecnologia nearshore que combina inovação, excelência técnica e agilidade para transformar negócios

Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. A flexibilidade é uma das nossas marcas registradas. Atuamos com diferentes modelos e formatos de time, adaptando-nos ao contexto de cada cliente. Nosso diferencial está em entregar soluções de ponta com uma equipe enxuta, eficiente e com mentalidade de dono.

O Que Você Vai Fazer

Estamos procurando um Senior Databricks Engineer com experiência na construção de pipelines e desenvolvimento de processos ETL no Databricks para agregar ao nosso Databricks CoE. Nesta função, você desempenhará um papel essencial na interseção entre negócios e tecnologia, combinando profundo conhecimento técnico com a capacidade de alinhar soluções tecnológicas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

O Que Estamos Buscando

  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente;
  • 5+ anos de experiência com manipulação e engenharia de dados
  • 5+ anos com processos ETL
  • 3+ anos de experiência com Databricks
  • 3+ anos de experiência com Azure
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Excelente comunicação e colaboração em equipe
  • Esta função pode gerar oportunidades de viagens domésticas e/ou internacionais;

Será Um Diferencial Se Você

  • Vivência em projetos internacionais e equipes multiculturais
  • Experiência com Power BI e integração entre engenharia e BI
  • Curiosidade e desejo de se envolver em diferentes etapas do ciclo de dados (desde ingestão até visualização)

Onde Você Vai Trabalhar

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota

Modalidade De Contratação

  • CLT ou PJ.

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description:
About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM ENGENHARIA DE DADOS | REMOTO
description:
LOCALIZA&CO

Estar em constante evolução nos trouxe até aqui. Ao lado de talentos e habilidades múltiplas nos conectamos em busca da nossa motivação: construir o futuro da mobilidade sustentável. É por meio da valorização da individualidade de cada um que impulsionamos o nosso movimento para conquistar resultados extraordinários, desenvolver nossas operações e criar soluções para os nossos clientes.

Somos apaixonados por nossa história, por nossas ideias e pela capacidade de realizá-las. Sabemos que juntos, todos vamos mais longe.

É assim que conectamos a Localiza&Co com o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar pipelines robustas, conectando dados de diversas fontes utilizando principalmente ferramentas do ecossistema AWS;
  • Implementar soluções de enriquecimento de dados escaláveis e eficientes utilizando o DBT para transformar dados brutos em modelos de dados personalizados e insights acionáveis para o negócio;
  • Gerenciar integrações, processos de transformação e automações de tarefas usando conectores de dados, APIs SQL, Python e Rest;
  • Utilizar SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Aplicar Spark para processamento de grandes volumes de dados em tempo real e em batch.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • AWS (Athena, S3, Glue, Lambda);
  • Proficiência em SQL, DBT, Python e Spark.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de dados como Apache Airflow;
  • Conhecimentos sobre diferentes técnicas de arquitetura e modelagem de dados para fins analíticos (Ex.: Data Mesh, Data Mart, Data Lake, Data Warehouse);
  • Experiência com Modelagem de Dados (relacional e/ou analítico) e processos ETL;
  • APIs, Gateways, Micro Serviços e Containers;
  • Noções sobre boas práticas de engenharia de software (Documentação, testes automatizados, código limpo, monitoramento).


Diferenciais:

  • Possuir Certificações AWS associadas à função de Cloud Data Engineer, sendo elas:
  • Cloud Practitioner;
  • Data Engineer;
  • Solutions Architect;
  • Machine Learning Engineer.


BENEFÍCIOS DESSA POSIÇÃO

  • Participação nos Lucros
  • Carro Corporativo
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Convênio Médico
  • Convênio Odontológico
  • Gympass
  • Previdência Privada
  • Auxílio Home Office
  • Allya
  • Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza
  • Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento
  • Desconto em compra e aluguel de veículos

title: Process Data & Integration Specialist - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Accounting Analyst position serves as the key internal contact for the company's financial information, with full visibility of transactions and responsibility for the source data used in decision-making. This role involves participating in regular monthly closing cycles and contributing to the development of the accounting work frame. You'll understand the financial data management model and use appropriate data retrieval tools to prepare and process accounting information in a highly versatile team that constantly adapts to changing business needs.


Key responsibilities


- Reconciling accounts.

- Verifying cost center allocation and other inputs of accounting transactions.

- Compiling financial statements.

- Registering accruals and applying corrections in the accounting system.

- Generating reports and supporting decision-making processes.


Requirements


- Accounting Experience: Experience in accounting, accounts payable, bookkeeping, or accounts receivable.

- Excel Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and Vlookup.

- ERP Systems: Experience with ERP management systems such as QuickBooks, Xero, SAP, or NetSuite.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: It Project Manager Intern
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented IT Project Manager Intern to support our technology team in planning, executing, and monitoring projects. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in project management, work with cross-functional teams, and learn industry best practices in a dynamic environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the planning and coordination of IT projects from initiation to delivery
  • Support project managers in defining scope, timelines, and deliverables
  • Track project progress and help maintain project documentation (plans, reports, meeting notes)
  • Participate in team meetings and provide status updates
  • Help identify risks, issues, and dependencies, and support mitigation plans
  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and business stakeholders
  • Assist in organizing project-related communications and documentation
  • Support the use of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar)


Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Basic understanding of project management concepts (Agile/Scrum is a plus)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) or Google Workspace
  • Ability to work in a team and manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Proactive, eager to learn, and detail-oriented


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Experience with project management tools (Jira, ClickUp, Monday.com, etc.)
  • Basic technical knowledge (software development lifecycle, APIs, etc.)


What You’ll Gain

  • Hands-on experience in IT project management
  • Exposure to real-world technology projects
  • Mentorship from experienced professionals
  • Opportunity to develop communication, leadership, and organizational skills

title: Senior Product Designer — Branding, UX/UI & SaaS Systems
description:
Strategy Analytics está desenvolvendo um ecossistema financeiro e tecnológico proprietário focado em infraestrutura digital, experiências SaaS, dashboards analíticos, branding institucional e interfaces de alta sofisticação visual.


Buscamos um Senior Product Designer com domínio avançado de Figma, UX/UI, branding e construção de sistemas visuais escaláveis.


A pessoa participará diretamente da criação da linguagem visual da empresa, estruturação de design systems, interfaces administrativas, dashboards financeiros, áreas do cliente, landing pages e arquitetura visual de produtos digitais proprietários.


Procuramos alguém com forte capacidade estética, pensamento sistêmico e experiência real em criação de plataformas modernas e interfaces premium.


Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolvimento de design systems completos

• Criação de interfaces SaaS e dashboards

• UX/UI para sistemas complexos

• Branding e identidade visual institucional

• Estruturação de componentes reutilizáveis

• Prototipação avançada no Figma

• Arquitetura visual escalável

• Criação de simbologias e linguagem visual proprietária


Diferenciais:

• Experiência em fintechs ou sistemas financeiros

• Experiência com produtos SaaS complexos

• Noções de front-end

• Motion/UI

• Forte percepção estética minimalista e premium

title: Business Development Representative - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.


Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


About the Role:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR), you’ll be at the forefront of CloudSEK’s growth. You’ll identify and qualify high-quality leads, nurture relationships with potential clients, and ultimately contribute to our mission of becoming Asia’s leading cybersecurity company.


Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience as an SDR/BDR in a SaaS company. If you have worked in the cybersecurity space, that would be awesome! If not, no worries, most of us are from different industries :)
  • We have a proven track record of successfully generating good quality leads, especially C-level.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written.
  • Excellent phone and email etiquette.
  • Know your way around CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot), and data providers (Apollo, Lusha). If not, the team is more than happy to work with you.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and a team player.
  • You are competitive, but with yourself. You set your benchmarks and break them every single quarter.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Prospecting: We will utilize various channels (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Apollo) to identify the right accounts and contacts within our target market.
  • Lead qualification : Assess and qualify leads based on specific criteria, ensuring they align with our ideal customer profile.
  • Lead generation: Multi-channel outreach (cold calling, email, Linkedin, looms..etc) to reach out to potential clients and book introductory meetings with the sales team
  • Relationship building: Build rapport and establish trust with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Pipeline development: Contribute to the sales pipeline by consistently generating qualified leads and opportunities.
  • CRM hygiene: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all activities and interactions within our CRM system.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team to ensure a smooth handover of qualified leads and opportunities.
  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, product updates, and competitive landscapes to enhance your outreach.
  • Language: Fluency in English

title: Ingeniero IaC — Terraform & Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
description:
Sobre a VMetrix

A VMetrix é uma Fintech B2B que está transformando a forma como as instituições financeiras gerenciam investimentos, risco e tesouraria. Nossa plataforma SaaS Front to Back to Risk permite que bancos, seguradoras, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e outras instituições financeiras implementem tecnologia de nível mundial em meses, não em anos, com um modelo flexível e escalável. 

Operamos em múltiplos países e trabalhamos com organizações onde as decisões são tomadas por meio de comitês de compra, licitações e processos altamente rigorosos, em um ambiente onde confiança, reputação e certeza são determinantes.  


O Papel

Você será o arquiteto e guardião da infraestrutura cloud da VMetrix. Automatizará, provisionará e gerenciará todos os recursos OCI por meio do Terraform, garantindo ambientes reproduzíveis, seguros e altamente disponíveis que sustentam nossa plataforma financeira crítica.


Se você é Ex-Oracle ou Ex-OCI, esta vaga foi feita para você. Candidate-se sem hesitar.


Requisitos Eliminatórios - Sem exceção:

Experiência obrigatória

  • 5+ anos em infraestrutura cloud (comprovável)
  • 3+ años trabalhando diretamente com Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • 5+ anos de domínio prático de Terraform (módulos, remote state, workspaces, backends)
  • Graduação em Engenharia da Computação, Redes, Sistemas ou área correlata


OCI — Domínio técnico não negociável

  • Networking: VCN, subnets, Security Lists, NSGs, IGW, NAT GW, Service GW, DRG
  • Compute: VMs, BM, instance pools, autoscaling, custom images
  • Storage: Object Storage, Block Volumes, File Storage, Archive Storage
  • Bancos de dados: Oracle DB 21c EE, Autonomous DB, MySQL HeatWave
  • IAM: compartimentos, políticas, dynamic groups, instance principals
  • OCI DevOps: Code Repos, Build Pipelines, Deployment Pipelines
  • Observabilidade: OCI Monitoring, Logging, Notifications, Events


Terraform & IaC — Domínio avançado

  • Variables, outputs, módulos, remote state, terraform.tfvars, backends OCI Object Storage
  • Gestão de múltiplos workspaces e ambientes (Dev / QA / Prod)
  • Integração com CI/CD: OCI DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins ou GitHub Actions
  • Git e GitFlow para versionamento de infraestrutura


Segurança Cloud

  • IAM policies, criptografia KMS/Vault, Audit Service no OCI
  • Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), CIS Benchmarks para OCI
  • Gestão de segredos: OCI Vault e/ou HashiCorp Vault


Perfil Diferencial — O que coloca você à frente:

  • Ex-funcionário ou ex-contratado da Oracle com experiência em suporte, implementação ou arquitetura OCI → MÁXIMO diferencial do processo
  • Portfólio comprovado em OCI + Terraform (repositórios Git públicos, artigos, open source)
  • Experiência em migrações cloud-to-cloud ou on-premises para OCI
  • Conhecimento de pricing e otimização de custos no OCI
  • Conhecimento de Terragrunt, Ansible ou ferramentas de gerenciamento de configuração
  • Containers: Docker e Kubernetes / OKE
  • Contribuições à comunidade (blog, meetups, palestras sobre OCI ou Terraform)


Certificações - Altamente desejáveis:

  • OCI Architect Professional (1Z0-997)
  • OCI DevOps Professional (1Z0-1109)
  • OCI Security Professional (1Z0-1104)
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003)


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix


En VMetrix não buscamos fazer “mais barulho”, mas construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relacionamentos de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, VMetrix é o lugar certo.

description:
• 12+ years of Ruby on Rails development experience

• API integration experience with 3rd party companies and systems (JSON,

ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML, etc)

• Front end skills (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, JQuery, etc)

• GO Development experience

• AWS a plus

Job Description

Responsible for the development and design of web applications and components. Design, code,

test, and implement web sites and applications, for either internal or external uses. Troubleshoot

and resolve issues surrounding performance, response times, capacity and system limitations.

Responsible for creating and modifying documentation corresponding to websites. May

collaborate with internal business partners, internal technology resources (database, system,

networking) and with external vendors. Maintain and update websites and ensure data quality,

integrity and consistency across organization. Requires both front-end (GUI) and back-end

development experience.

Job Details

• Maintenance and feature development for existing Rails 6/7 application Domain focused

on electronic recyclables - inventory, scheduling, transportation, management, and

processing

• API integrations with 3rd party companies and internal applications

Qualifications

• Expert knowledge of the Ruby on Rails framework and Ruby as a core language (10

years minimum)

• Extensive knowledge of API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST,

RPC, XML, etc)

• Working knowledge of basic frontend development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap,

JQuery, etc)

• Working knowledge of Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins, etc)

• Working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest, etc)

Education

• 4-year degree or technical training program (bootcamp, etc)

title: SAP OTC Functional Consultant Sr.
description:
Senior SAP OTC Functional Consultant (Mexico & Brazil Only)

We’re not looking for someone to “support SAP.”

We’re looking for someone who owns Order-to-Cash end-to-end and knows how to keep it running under pressure.

If you’ve worked in complex SAP environments (S/4HANA + ECC) , handled real business impact, and can step in without hand-holding—keep reading.

title: GCP Cloud Architect | Specialist (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos, workshops e palestras (principalmente em espanhol) sobre GCP;
  • Desenvolver demonstrações práticas (hands-on) e provas de conceito (PoCs);
  • Apoiar clientes na adoção de soluções de modernização de aplicações e infraestrutura;
  • Desenhar arquiteturas em nuvem escaláveis, resilientes e seguras;
  • Atuar em estratégias de migração para cloud (cloud migration);
  • Colaborar com times técnicos e de negócio na qualificação de oportunidades;
  • Disseminar boas práticas, tendências e inovações em cloud;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação digital com foco em soluções serverless e cloud-native;
  • Interagir com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio em toda a América Latina.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Google Cloud Platform (GCP);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de soluções em cloud e desenho de soluções escaláveis;
  • Vivência com modernização de aplicações e arquiteturas cloud-native e serverless;
  • Experiência com serviços GCP como Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine, VPC, IAM, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud Monitoring e Cloud Logging;
  • Experiência com containers e orquestração, incluindo Docker e Kubernetes / Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE);
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC), especialmente com Terraform;
  • Experiência com CI/CD e práticas de DevOps;
  • Vivência com migração de ambientes para nuvem (Cloud Migration);
  • Conhecimento em redes (networking) e ambientes Linux;
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento de sistemas distribuídos;
  • Experiência em gestão e consumo de APIs (API Management);
  • Atuação em arquitetura de soluções (Solution Architecture);
  • Espanhol avançado para condução de apresentações e treinamentos.



Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Firebase;
  • Conhecimento em BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de APIs via Apigee;
  • Vivência com Enterprise Scheduler Service;
  • Experiência com Anthos;
  • Conhecimento em Cloud SQL e Memorystore;
  • Experiência com AI/ML na GCP, incluindo Vertex AI;
  • Conhecimento em Looker;
  • Experiência com Kafka;
  • Vivência com GitOps, incluindo ArgoCD;
  • Conhecimento em Istio;
  • Experiência com FinOps;
  • Práticas de SRE (Site Reliability Engineering);
  • Conhecimento em segurança em cloud (Security Best Practices).

title: Azure DevOps | MID (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar e implementar soluções de infraestrutura em Azure, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e segurança;
  • Desenvolver arquiteturas avançadas com foco em contêineres e orquestração utilizando Kubernetes;
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, operações e segurança na construção de soluções integradas;
  • Avaliar e recomendar tecnologias e ferramentas adequadas para desafios de infraestrutura;
  • Realizar análises de performance e propor otimizações em sistemas e aplicações;
  • Documentar arquiteturas, soluções e boas práticas operacionais;
  • Atuar no suporte técnico durante implementação e pós-implementação;
  • Liderar iniciativas de automação de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform, Ansible e scripts personalizados.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura de soluções com foco em infraestrutura Azure;
  • Sólido conhecimento em serviços Azure, como: Azure Storage (Blob, File, Queue), Azure Networking (VNETs, Subnets, NSG, UDR, VPN Gateway, Application Gateway), Azure Service Bus e Event Grid e Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS);
  • Experiência com automação utilizando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ferramentas similares;
  • Vivência em gerenciamento e orquestração de contêineres com Kubernetes e Istio;
  • Conhecimento avançado em redes e service mesh;
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps e CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines);
  • Experiência na construção de soluções resilientes, com alta disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas;
  • Forte habilidade em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa comunicação, capacidade de apresentação e atuação colaborativa em equipe.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of C# and 2+ years of modern JavaScript framework experience, such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js, to join the software engineering team of our U.S. client. The right candidate must have a passion for building seriously cool technology, delivering on time, utilizing industry best practices, and working in a fast-paced environment.


Our client is on a mission to make people more productive by providing cloud-based, document management and file sharing solutions that automate routine, repetitive tasks. They are a subsidiary of a publicly traded company that trades on the London Stock Exchange. With hundreds of thousands of users already onboard today, our client is in growth mode, building new products to serve the U.S., the United Kingdom, and Australia / New Zealand markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop robust, high-quality, front- and back-end product features
  • Develop integrations using external and internal APIs
  • Apply good development practices following team standards, and look for opportunities to improve and innovate
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Assist the development team in troubleshooting

title: Senior BackEnd Engineer
description:
We are seeking to bring on board a Senior BackEnd Engineer with a deep understanding of Java programming, software development methodologies and the ability to design, develop and maintain complex Java based applications, while also contributing significantly to the technical excellence of the team.


Responsibilities

  • Exceptional problem solving skills to identify and solve complex technical issues efficiently.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate frontend and backend components seamlessly.
  • Communicates effectively with team members, stakeholders and non-technical persons and also collaborates well within a team, sharing knowledge and mentoring junior developers.
  • Shows a strong commitment to learning and staying up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.


Technology Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience as backend developer.
  • Proficient in Java 21, dependency injections frameworks, Relational and Non-Relational Databases.
  • Emphasizes the importance of testing, automated testing frameworks and writing unit tests.
  • Can design RESTful APIs, architect software systems (taking into consideration scalability, maintainability and performance).
  • Familiar with design patterns, microservices and other software design principles.
  • Familiar with DevOps practices (CI, CD and deployments pipelines). Utilizes tools like Git, Docker, and Kubernetes for development and deployment.
  • Experience working with integration of payment processing platforms, design, develop and optimize API connections to enable smooth payment workflows.
  • Experience with any scripting languages.


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.
  • Experience in frontend development is a plus.

  • Influence without authority to drive accountability, resolve blockers, and maintain momentum

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Ruby on Rails)
description:
About The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Full-Stack Engineer to work on reverse supply chain processes, including trade-ins, recycling, repairs, and returns. The role involves maintaining and enhancing an existing Rails 6/7 application focused on electronic recyclables, covering inventory, scheduling, transportation, management, and processing.


Responsibilities


  • Design, develop, and maintain web applications and components using Ruby on Rails.
  • Build and integrate APIs with 3rd party companies and internal applications.
  • Collaborate with internal partners and external vendors to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve performance, response time, and capacity issues.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation and ensure data integrity across systems.
  • Perform both front-end (GUI) and back-end development tasks.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience with Ruby on Rails development
  • Strong expertise in API design and integration (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML, etc).
  • Proficiency in front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, JQuery).
  • Experience with Continuous Integration tools (CircleCI, Jenkins).
  • Familiarity with testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical training.
  • Advanced English.


Nice To Have Skills

  • Experience with Go development.
  • AWS knowledge and hands-on cloud experience.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to optimize performance and scalability.

title: Senior Writer
description:
Senior Writer (Roteirista)

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.


Role Overview

As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.


Key Responsibilities

1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy

  • Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization.
  • Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy.
  • Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons.

2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight

  • Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers.
  • Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth.
  • Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation.
  • Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production.

3. Team Management & Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows.
  • Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team.
  • Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team.
  • Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact.

4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization

  • Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion.
  • Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback.
  • Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth.

5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control

  • Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output.
  • Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content.
  • Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output.

6. User-Centric Content Improvement

  • Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches.
  • Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges.
  • Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement.

7. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets.
  • Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans.
  • Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders.

8. Promotion & Growth Strategy

  • Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows.
  • Ensure promos align with the show’s narrative hook and audience appeal.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms.
  • Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams.
  • Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies.
  • Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.


Key Traits for Success

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance
  • Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively
  • Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams
  • Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise
  • Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making

title: Designer
description:
Sobre o Studio Yellow

No Studio Yellow, somos uma agência premium global especializada em transformar marcas através de design inovador e estratégia de ponta. Atuamos como parceiros de crescimento para empresas líderes, criando experiências centradas no usuário que unem o melhor da inteligência artificial com a arte da criatividade humana. Nosso trabalho vai muito além de capturar a atenção; nós construímos conexões significativas que geram engajamento e lealdade duradouros. Com um time altamente engajado e uma cultura 100% remota, colaboramos em projetos de impacto nacional e internacional, sempre com um compromisso inegociável com a excelência.


O Papel

Estamos em busca de um designer versátil , criativo e com um olhar afiado para a excelência. Se você é apaixonado por criar soluções visuais que não apenas encantam, mas também resolvem problemas estratégicos, este é o seu lugar. Como parte do nosso time, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em projetos diversificados, desde a concepção de identidades visuais, design de posts para social media, até o design de interfaces (UI/UX) e materiais para campanhas digitais e impressas. Você trabalhará lado a lado com uma equipe multidisciplinar e talentosa, lidando com clientes globais e elevando o padrão de qualidade em cada entrega.


O que você fará no dia a dia

Sua rotina envolverá a criação de ativos visuais de alta qualidade para diversos formatos, incluindo digital, print, social media e apresentações premium. Além disso, atuará como um guardião da marca, garantindo que todas as entregas estejam perfeitamente alinhadas com as diretrizes e a estratégia de marca dos nossos clientes.


A colaboração criativa será uma parte fundamental do seu trabalho. Você participará ativamente de brainstormings, trazendo ideias inovadoras e colaborando com times de estratégia, conteúdo e tecnologia. A busca pela excelência guiará suas ações, exigindo que você itere sobre feedbacks de forma construtiva e refine cada detalhe para garantir que o resultado final seja nada menos que excepcional.


O que buscamos em você

Procuramos um profissional com um portfólio de impacto, que demonstre forte habilidade em design gráfico e narrativa visual, além de um domínio impecável de tipografia, layout e teoria das cores. É essencial ter proficiência avançada nas principais ferramentas de design, como Figma e Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).


A versatilidade é uma característica chave que buscamos, pois você precisará transitar entre diferentes estilos e formatos, adaptando-se às necessidades de projetos nacionais e internacionais.


Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração são necessárias para articular e defender suas ideias de design de forma clara, além de trabalhar bem em um ambiente remoto e colaborativo.


Conhecimentos em motion design, edição básica de vídeo ou familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao design serão considerados diferenciais muito bem-vindos.


Por que o Studio Yellow?

Ao se juntar ao Studio Yellow, você terá a oportunidade de atuar globalmente, trabalhando em projetos desafiadores para marcas de destaque no Brasil e no mundo. Você fará parte de uma cultura premium, em uma agência que valoriza a qualidade extrema e a inovação em cada detalhe.


Oferecemos liberdade e flexibilidade através de um ambiente 100% remoto, permitindo que você trabalhe de onde se sentir mais inspirado, com autonomia e responsabilidade. Acima de tudo, você se juntará a um time inspirador de profissionais apaixonados e engajados, em um espaço que fomenta o crescimento contínuo e a troca de conhecimentos.


Se você tem o talento para transformar estratégia em arte e a ambição de entregar o extraordinário, queremos conhecer você.


Venha construir o futuro das marcas com o Studio Yellow!

  • Atuação em ecossistemas Oracle e integração end-to-end de sistemas

  • Forte interação com stakeholders executivos (C-Level)
  • Gestão de escopo, prazo, custo, risco e governança

  • Foco em previsibilidade de entregas e controle rigoroso dos projetos
  • Alta capacidade de execução, tomada de decisão e atuação em cenários complexos e de pressão

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision.
  • Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs.
  • Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance.
  • Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations.
  • Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots.

System Requirements (Mandatory):

Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or macOS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won’t be accepted.

  • Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40MBPS


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.


Equal Opportunity

Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

title: Analista Administrativo Jr - Direito Tributário e Societário
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.


Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.


Sobre o Papel

A função envolve a preparação de documentos legais e a gestão de processos na JUCEPA, além de oferecer suporte administrativo ao departamento jurídico.


Responsabilidades

  • Preparar os instrumentos de alteração contratual;
  • Elaborar atas de assembleia ordinária e extraordinária;
  • Emitir procurações;
  • Realizar apurações e registros nos processos na JUCEPA;
  • Catalogar e classificar os atos societários registrados;
  • Processar guias de custas, taxas da JUCEPA e custas judiciais;
  • Comunicar e registrar prazos e atualizações processuais de natureza cível e administrativa;
  • Auxiliar na rotina administrativa do departamento jurídico;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas sob orientação do seu superior.


Qualificações

Ensino Médio Completo.

Desejável Ensino Superior Completo em Direito, Administração, Gestão de Empresas e afins.


A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:

title: Analista de Customer Success Pleno | Produto RH
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Customer Success II para atuar na implantação (onboarding) de clientes da vertical de Capital Humano, com foco em execução de projetos, alinhamento entre stakeholders e geração de valor desde os primeiros marcos da jornada.

Essa posição será responsável por conduzir projetos de onboarding com diferentes níveis de complexidade, garantindo organização, cumprimento de prazos e qualidade na entrega, mesmo em cenários fora do fluxo padrão.

Procuramos um perfil com forte capacidade de execução, organização e relacionamento, que atue com protagonismo na condução dos projetos e tenha facilidade em navegar entre múltiplos stakeholders.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Conduzir o onboarding de clientes B2B, garantindo alinhamento de expectativas, clareza de escopo e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Estruturar e gerenciar cronogramas de implantação, acompanhando entregas, dependências e riscos ao longo da jornada;
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato do cliente durante o onboarding, garantindo comunicação clara e acompanhamento contínuo;
  • Conduzir reuniões de projeto (kickoff, checkpoints, treinamentos e follow-ups), assegurando evolução do cliente ao longo da jornada;
  • Gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, mantendo organização e priorização das demandas;
  • Identificar riscos, desvios e oportunidades de melhoria durante a execução, propondo planos de ação;
  • Monitorar indicadores de sucesso como adoção, engajamento e satisfação do cliente;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas internas (Produto, Suporte, Comercial), garantindo fluidez nas entregas;
  • Garantir registros e acompanhamento estruturado das interações e demandas dos clientes;
  • Contribuir com melhorias de processos, trazendo visão crítica e sugestões baseadas na operação.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Onboarding ou Atendimento ao Cliente B2B;
  • Vivência prática com gestão de projetos (planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de cronogramas);
  • Experiência com múltiplos stakeholders e condução de agendas estruturadas;
  • Capacidade de organização e gestão de múltiplas demandas simultâneas;
  • Boa leitura de indicadores e acompanhamento de performance do cliente;

title: Emerging Market Trader - LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS)
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in LATAM currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities:


FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on LATAM markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:

  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.

Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.


Requirements

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.

Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS)

Experience working at:

  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks

Hands-on experience building or optimizing:

  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.

Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: Video Content Creator
description:
DesignRush.com, a B2B Media Platform that drives brand discovery & growth, is seeking a Video Content Creator with the vision and capability to increase our social following and traffic to our site from various social platforms.


Primary responsibilities:


  • Produce engaging social content relevant to our target audience and our brand
  • Substantially increase social media engagement and follower count
  • Drive traffic to the site


We offer GROWTH, job stability, and a work culture that enables our teammates to excel in their careers.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position.


DesignRush is seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Responsibilities


  • Create a social media strategy and calendar for various social platforms
  • Deliver at least four long-form YouTube videos weekly, plus short-form content
  • Develop and execute original ideas, scripts, and concepts end-to-end
  • Craft all creatives, including messaging, design, and video
  • Produce content focused on marketing and B2B topics to drive traffic and growth
  • Utilize AI to generate content ideas and help with execution
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Build and engage a professional online community through impactful content
  • Represent the brand consistently and professionally across all platforms
  • Optimize YouTube performance through SEO, thumbnails, and high-retention content
  • Use social trends (sounds, challenges, formats) to expand reach and visibility
  • Track and analyze performance metrics to continuously improve results


Requirements


  • 5+ years of experience creating content for YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram
  • Proven experience in B2B and/or media environments.
  • Strong copywriting and storytelling skills to produce engaging, on-brand content
  • Proficient in social media tools, analytics, and video editing software
  • Progressive thinker and avid user of AI
  • Passionate about communication, creativity, and making an impact
  • Able to work between 6 AM and 3 PM EST


Recruitment Steps:


  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Complete a short questionnaire
  • Submit answers and CV
  • Interview with the Recruitment team
  • Complete a technical test
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager(s)
  • Receive feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Data & AI Tech Lead
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Finance Data Specialist
description:
Nosso time de Dados

Nosso time de dados é responsável por empoderar as equipes da Nuvemshop para tomarem as melhores decisões, transformando dados em acionáveis. Trabalhamos em colaboração para ajudar a criar uma cultura de trabalho apoiada em dados, que lhes permite atingir seus objetivos de forma eficiente, fornecendo a infraestrutura e as ferramentas necessárias para apoiar essas equipes.


O tamanho do seu desafio

  • Ser ponto focal da equipe de Analytics para Finance, atuando como referência técnica e estratégica na identificação proativa de problemas de negócio;
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e a manutenção de modelos financeiros e análises preditivas que suportem decisões estratégicas de receita, custos e investimentos;
  • Implementar as melhores práticas de visualização de dados para criar insights significativos e torná-los acionáveis;
  • Construir soluções com novas métricas e painéis de controle que ajudem as equipes de Finance a tomarem as melhores decisões;
  • Conduzir análises de variância (real vs. orçado) e identificar oportunidades de otimização de custos e melhoria de margens;
  • Encontrar 80/20s que possam maximizar o ROI do que fazemos;
  • Encontrar correlações entre diferentes ações e resultados financeiros com foco em rentabilidade, fluxo de caixa e eficiência operacional;
  • Automatizar processos de reporting financeiro e reduzir dependência de análises manuais, propondo soluções escaláveis;
  • Melhorar o que entendemos sobre o negócio para desbloquear novas possibilidades.


O que buscamos

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL;
  • Experiência em DBT para modelagem de dados;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados (preferencialmente Tableau);
  • Experiência trabalhando com equipes financeiras, com entendimento aprofundado de conceitos como P&L, forecast, budget, unit economics e análise de variância;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de FP&A ou ERPs;
  • Base sólida em estatística descritiva e modelagem financeira;
  • Capacidade de abstrair e focar em informações/fatos relevantes em uma ampla gama de dados;
  • Habilidade comprovada de influenciar stakeholders e traduzir dados complexos em recomendações claras e acionáveis para liderança;
  • Histórico de atuação autônoma em projetos complexos, com capacidade de definir escopo, priorizar entregas e conduzir análises end-to-end;
  • Excelentes habilidades de relacionamento, colaboração e planejamento.


São diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de Python para análise;
  • Experiência aplicando inteligência artificial generativa (GenAI) para acelerar análises de dados, automação de workflows ou geração de insights;
  • Experiência em e-commerce ou empresas de tecnologia SaaS.


Nosso processo

Queremos que você tenha a melhor experiência possível ao longo do nosso processo seletivo. Após a sua inscrição, o time de Talent Acquisition irá analisar seu perfil com atenção e, independentemente do resultado, você receberá um retorno. As etapas e prazos podem variar de acordo com cada vaga, mas não se preocupe — que nos manteremos em contato com você.


O que temos para você

  • Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash Benefícios: Plataforma que reúne vale alimentação, vale refeição e outras categorias como educação, entretenimento, cultura, saúde, bem-estar, auxílio home office e muito mais;
  • Aulas de espanhol semanais gratuitas;
  • Totalpass: As melhores redes de parcerias para atividades físicas, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e qualidade do sono, com diversos planos disponíveis;
  • Descontos nos cursos da Coderhouse;
  • Auxílio creche para crianças de até 5 anos;
  • Licença de família estendida para 21 dias corridos para pessoas não grávidas ou adotantes. A licença maternidade é de 4 meses e a licença parental de 21 dias. O benefício também vale para famílias que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homoafetivos;
  • Além das férias, temos uma semana de descanso para recarregar as energias no final/começo do ano;
